cs.t: I’ve every-day-carried a number of expensive knives of various sizes over the years. I eventually landed on the tiny and cheap Swiss Army Classic SD. I am a knowledge worker who mostly sits at a desk during the week. It easily serves for everything that I need a knife to do and then some with its tweezers, scissors, toothpick, and nail file. It’s very small and light. It’s also cheap enough that I don’t really care if I lose one to carelessness or a security checkpoint.  https://www.amazon.com/dp/B00004YVB2/ref=cm_sw_r_sms_c_api_u...  When I’m camping, I carry a Leatherman multitool.
cs.th: Ask HN: What is your favorite pocket knife?
